sentenceSets.sentence: The policy had a long gestation, moving through committees and consultations for nearly two years before emerging.

answerChoices.reasoning: A delay is dead time in which nothing happens, but the two years described are filled with committee work and consultation that shaped the policy.
Debate names argument over a proposal that already exists, while this period is what the policy passed through before it emerged at all.
A trial tests a policy in operation, which can only happen after it exists, whereas this stretch precedes its emergence.
A campaign is a push to win support for something already formulated, not the internal process of committees and consultations that produced it.
Revision reworks an existing draft, but the sentence covers the whole span before the policy came into being.
Implementation follows emergence, and the two years are explicitly placed before it.
An audit reviews something in force, while nothing was yet in force during these two years.
A rollout is the staged introduction of a finished policy, the opposite end of the timeline from what the sentence describes.
Collapse would mean the policy failed, contradicting its emergence after two years.
Repeal cancels an existing policy and cannot precede its first appearance.
Expiration is the end of a policy's life, not the period before it began.

sentenceSets.sentence: Elephants have the longest gestation of any land mammal, nearly two years from conception to birth.

answerChoices.reasoning: Infancy begins after birth, but the span measured here runs from conception up to the moment of birth.
A lifespan covers the whole life, which for an elephant far exceeds the two years the sentence bounds by conception and birth.
Maturation describes growing to adulthood, a process that occurs after the animal is born.
Hibernation is a seasonal dormancy and has nothing to do with the interval between conception and birth.
Migration is seasonal travel and cannot be measured from conception to birth.
Lactation is the nursing period that follows delivery, not the time leading up to it.
Molting is the shedding of a coat or feathers and is unrelated to prenatal development.
Courtship precedes conception, whereas the span given starts at conception itself.
Extinction is the loss of a whole species and cannot be a duration within an individual's reproduction.
Digestion is the processing of food and has no bearing on the interval before birth.
Domestication happens to populations over generations and is not bounded by conception and birth.

sentenceSets.sentence: The novel had a gestation of eleven years, most of it spent on a version the author eventually threw away.

answerChoices.reasoning: A run is how long a published work stays in print or on sale, but these eleven years were spent on a draft that never reached readers.
Revision reworks a completed manuscript, whereas the sentence covers the whole stretch before the book existed, including a version abandoned entirely.
Reception is how readers responded, which can only follow publication and has nothing to do with a discarded draft.
Serialization publishes a work in installments, but the eleven years were private labor on material the author threw out.
An advance is a payment from a publisher and is not a period of time.
Printing is a manufacturing step measured in weeks, not the long stretch of composition described.
Translation happens to a finished book, while this time was spent on a version the author discarded.
A dedication is a few lines at the front of a book, not a span of years.
An epilogue is a section at the end of a novel and cannot last eleven years.
A sequel is a later book and could not precede the one being described.
Royalties are earnings after publication and are not a period of composition.
